screen.rationale: Poly(DMODT-co-caprolactone) degraded with BTZ photocatalysts under 420 nm light (passes E1-E4), but the only quantitative endpoint is the normalized SEC early-elution peak area decrease (e.g. 53% and 31% over 10 h); no Mn/Mw/Mp before and after irradiation and no yield of an identified product (acetone only qualitative) are reported.

excluded_observations.what: Normalized SEC peak-area decreases (31%, 53% at 10 h; final 38%/65% after 24 h)
excluded_observations.why: Peak-area metric, not a molar-mass average or product yield (out of v1.0 scope).
Only in figures/SI (Figure 2a, Figure S14); no Mn/Mw values in text.
Small-molecule monomer, not a polymer substrate.
